# jochwacht-sbom 0.12.2 — the question before sending said the old name

Right before anything leaves your machine, the tool asks for confirmation.
That question still read **"Send this to jochwacht?"** — the most
consequential sentence in the tool, and the one the previous fix could not
see: 0.12.1 checked the `--help` output, and a prompt is not in `--help`.

Nothing else changed.

The guard now reads every string literal in the CLI, so prompts, errors and
hints are covered the same way. Verified red on the exact line that shipped.
